title: Otori Emu — A Momentary Reunion〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: G-GGGGGGGGG...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: GRANDPA?!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
Yes, the very same!
What's the hubbub? You look like a pigeon that just got shot by a peashooter.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I-I mean, Grandpa, you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: “Grandpa and Emu Secrets Quiz!!!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?! A-A quiz?!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Emu, could you quiz me on something that only I'd know the answer to?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Ask as many questions as you like. I'll keep answering them all until you're satisfied!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Th-Then...! Um...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What was the name of the first show I saw with you at the Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: I know this! “Teddy In The Magical Forest”!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ding ding ding! Perfect answer☆

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: My oh my. Is that enough quizzing? I've only answered one question, you know.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's enough! I mean, I knew it was you the second you suggested a quiz!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Even if this is all a dream, I'm super duper happy...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I haven't dreamt about him at all since I had to say goodbye...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Is this because I was wishing I could've talked to him more?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (If this is a dream, I'd better talk to him lots and lots before I wake up!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um, Grandpa! There's so much I wanna talk about!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: There's something I was hoping to get your thoughts on too, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, my thoughts?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: That's right. Look, over there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Over there... Are you talking about the dollhouse on the table?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Indeed. You see, I've been thinking about ways to renovate this lodge.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Lodge...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! You mean the stuff about rock climbing up to the second floor or making the bathroom an aquarium?!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
Ah! Did your dad tell you?
That's exactly right!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: To start, I've put together a dollhouse so I can better imagine how things will turn out.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: So, I wanted to ask you what sort of lodge you would make... Ah, but a brainstorming battle sounds much more interesting!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You and me are gonna face off?!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: These old legs wouldn't be a match for yours, but I won't lose to the young folk when it comes to a contest of ideas!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, I've been learning all kinds of stuff at Shunmeiza, on a movie set and all sorts of other places!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I'll do my best to keep up with you and come up with some super shiny sparkly ideas☆

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Yes, that's it! That's the way!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
There are plenty of furniture miniatures!
Use whichever you like and propose lots of variations.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okie dokie!
Whoa...! There are even little dolls of us!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Cute, aren't they? They're my pride and joy, made to order.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
Okay then, are we all set for our brainstorming battle?
Ready... Go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gooo!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hmm, what to do. Grandpa already came up with ideas to make the place feel like a playground or an aquarium...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That reminds me, he wrote in his notebook about how difficult it was to climb the stairs and how many memories are packed in here.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Trouble climbing the stairs... Then...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh... But I think this idea would mean making really big changes to the lodge...)

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Emu, that's the face of somebody with an idea! Keeping all the fun to yourself is no fair. Could you let Grandpa in on it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um... I thought you could have a ramp heading up to the second floor, instead of stairs. I figured that would be easier on you...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Aha! Go on.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: An easy slope would mean a reeeally long ramp, so I thought it might be nice to put in windows looking out at the yard or hang some family photos. That way, you wouldn't get bored on the walk.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
I see! That's quite the interesting idea.
So, why did you look so down?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, I realized making that long ramp would probably mean you have to remodel the lodge a whole lot.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But this lodge is full of so many memories, right? So...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: So you were thinking about us. You're so kindhearted, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
But this is an idea you came up with.
It'd be a waste to never put it in words!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Listen, Emu. The way I see it, sharing an idea is a very meaningful thing to do.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: After all, a thought that seems obvious to you could feel like an incredible epiphany to someone else.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: And even when it's an idea you're not sure how to execute, maybe someone out there has the answer.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
Haven't you experienced that before, Emu?
Moments when something you thought impossible came to fruition with the help of those around you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah. Lots of times...!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Of course, of course you have!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
Ideas are the seeds of dreams!
Planting more will cause all sorts to bloom!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: So, Emu! Give me lots of ideas! If you don't, how are you supposed to beat your Grandpa?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh right, we were competing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um, then...! How about putting a rail cart in the yard?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The yard looks super spacious, so if there was a rail cart, you could go all around and really enjoy the nature!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: I like that! And planting some flowers along the tracks would surely make for a beautiful sight.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, about the inside of the lodge... Oh, can I use the dollhouse?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
Of course!
Which part are you thinking of changing up?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, well...!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait... Where's the lodge? Where's Grandpa?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Grandpa?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sorry, Emu. It's me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Listen to this! I was with my grandpa until just now! And we were having a brainstorming battle!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And...! And...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I guess it really was a dream.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I suppose it was something similar...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Emu, you picked up some sort of glowing ball, right? That's called a fragment of a feeling, and it allows you to get in touch with someone else's emotions.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A fragment of a feeling...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, after you touched that fragment of a feeling, you were taken to a fragment SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! That was a SEKAI too?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't know what kind of SEKAI it was...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But even if it was a fragment, someone's feelings were here, and you took them on.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It may not have been real... But it wasn't just a dream, either.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh... I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I...talked to Grandpa there. We talked about the family lodge... Oh, we never got to finish our brainstorming battle.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we got to...we got to talk lots and lots.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He listened to all my ideas. He told me he liked them, and they sounded fun...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then... And then...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sob*
*Sniffle*
Hey, that's weird...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just had so much fun, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: MEIKO...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
There's no one else around.
So, you don't need to hold it in.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... I have this feeling that if I cry, the tears are gonna take away everything me and Grandpa talked about together, and everything I felt.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I'm gonna write it all down before I forget!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's a wonderful plan! I'd love to hear what you two talked about.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure♪ I'll tell you all about it!
